questions.q: What plumbing work have you done? Tell us if it was houses, apartments or big buildings, and what jobs like pipe fitting, bathroom fitting or leak repair?
questions.looks_for: Specific work and pipe types (CPVC, PVC, GI), fittings installed, new work vs repair, where and how long. Honest about their own role.
questions.te: మీరు ఏ plumbing పని చేశారు? ఇళ్ళు, apartments లేదా పెద్ద buildings లోనా, pipe fitting, bathroom fitting లేదా leak repair లాంటి ఏ jobs చేశారు చెప్పండి?
questions.hi: आपने कौन सा plumbing काम किया है? घर, apartments या बड़ी buildings में, और pipe fitting, bathroom fitting या leak repair जैसे कौन से jobs किए, बताइए?

questions.q: Tell us about one plumbing job you are proud of. What was the problem and how did you fix it?
questions.looks_for: A concrete job: how they found the problem (hidden leak, low pressure, blockage), what they did, and how they tested it so it did not come back.
questions.te: మీకు గర్వంగా అనిపించిన ఒక plumbing పని గురించి చెప్పండి. Problem ఏంటి, మీరు ఎలా సరిచేశారు?
questions.hi: किसी एक plumbing काम के बारे में बताइए जिस पर आपको गर्व है। Problem क्या थी और आपने उसे कैसे ठीक किया?

questions.q: A tap joint under the kitchen sink is leaking. How will you fix it, step by step?
questions.looks_for: Closes the angle valve or main valve, keeps a bucket and cloth, finds exactly where it leaks, tightens or replaces the washer, connection pipe or fitting, uses teflon tape properly, opens water and checks for leaks, cleans up.
questions.te: Kitchen sink కింద tap joint దగ్గర leak అవుతోంది. మీరు step by step ఎలా సరిచేస్తారు?
questions.hi: Kitchen sink के नीचे tap का joint leak हो रहा है। आप step by step कैसे ठीक करेंगे?

questions.q: How do you fit a CPVC or PVC pipe joint so that it does not leak later?
questions.looks_for: Cuts the pipe straight, removes burrs, cleans, dry-fits first, uses the correct solvent cement for that pipe, pushes and turns slightly, holds a few seconds, lets it set before pressure, then does a pressure or water test.
questions.te: CPVC లేదా PVC pipe joint ని తర్వాత leak అవ్వకుండా ఎలా fit చేస్తారు?
questions.hi: CPVC या PVC pipe का joint कैसे fit करते हैं ताकि बाद में leak न हो?

questions.q: A bathroom drain is blocked and water is not going down. How will you clear it without damaging the pipe?
questions.looks_for: Removes the jali and takes out hair and dirt, uses a plunger, then a drain spring or rod gently, checks the trap, uses hot water; avoids strong acid that can damage pipes and hurt people; wears gloves; tests flow afterwards.
questions.te: Bathroom drain block అయ్యి నీళ్ళు పోవడం లేదు. Pipe పాడవకుండా మీరు దాన్ని ఎలా clear చేస్తారు?
questions.hi: Bathroom की drain block है और पानी नीचे नहीं जा रहा। Pipe को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना आप उसे कैसे साफ़ करेंगे?

questions.q: You finish a job, but the customer calls and says water is now leaking into the flat below, and he is very angry. What will you do?
questions.looks_for: Stays calm, says sorry, goes back quickly or asks them to close the valve, checks their own work honestly, fixes it, helps clean up, informs the office; does not blame others without checking.
questions.te: మీరు పని పూర్తి చేశారు, కానీ ఇప్పుడు కింది flat లోకి నీళ్ళు leak అవుతున్నాయని customer చాలా కోపంగా call చేశారు. మీరు ఏం చేస్తారు?
questions.hi: आपने काम पूरा कर दिया, लेकिन customer बहुत गुस्से में call करता है कि अब नीचे वाले flat में पानी leak हो रहा है। आप क्या करेंगे?

questions.q: Why do you want to work as a plumber? When can you join, and what salary do you expect? Can you say your notice period and salary clearly?
questions.looks_for: A genuine reason for this work, a clear joining date or notice period, and a clear salary figure. May mention own tools.
questions.te: మీరు plumber గా ఎందుకు పని చేయాలనుకుంటున్నారు? ఎప్పుడు join అవ్వగలరు, ఎంత salary ఆశిస్తున్నారు? మీ notice period, salary స్పష్టంగా చెప్పగలరా?
questions.hi: आप plumber का काम क्यों करना चाहते हैं? आप कब join कर सकते हैं, और कितनी salary चाहते हैं? क्या आप अपना notice period और salary साफ़ बता सकते हैं?
